download_character_render.description: The same picture Render character links to, fetched and stored as a document, for a step that needs the file rather than a link: an email attachment, an upload, a file posted into a chat. Answers with the document and the links beside it.

parameters.description: The equipment the character wears: item ids from Search items, as a list from an earlier step or separated by commas, up to 30. Hair (30000s), faces (20000s), hats, tops, bottoms, shoes, weapons and cash covers all count. Leave empty for a bare character.

parameters.description: The skin to draw the body in: 2000 is the light skin and the default; the others run from 2001 upward. The matching head is added for you.

parameters.description: Which game client's data to read: GMS is the global game, KMS the Korean, JMS the Japanese, and so on. Defaults to GMS. Names come in the client's language, so KMS answers in Korean.

parameters.description: Which build of the client to read, such as 255, or latest for the newest MapleStory.IO lists, which is the default. List regions and versions gives every version of every region. Ids are the same across versions; what changes is which items, mobs and maps exist.

parameters.description: Draw the character with elf ears, as a Mercedes has. Off by default.

parameters.description: Mirror the picture so the character faces right rather than left, the way the game draws them. Off by default.

parameters.description: Optional. A name to draw under the character's feet, as the game does, up to 13 characters.

version.description: The version read, e.g. '270': the one asked for, or the newest when latest was.

description: Read MapleStory's game data through MapleStory.IO, a free community API that serves what each region's game client holds: every item, monster, NPC, map and pet, with icons and sprites, from the global game to the Korean, Japanese and other clients and back through their versions. Search items and read what one needs and gives, look up a monster's level, HP and spawn maps, read what an NPC says and where it stands, see what is on a map and where its portals lead, find a pet, and draw a character wearing any set of items in any pose, as a PNG or an animated GIF, linked or downloaded as a file. No API key needed.
